//: Confidence gates for the Plate Recognizer Stream engine at LJS.
//_WARNING: These are on PR's score scale. They MUST be applied in the
//_WARNING2: SAME change that sets alpr.engine to 'pr_stream'. Applying
//_WARNING3: them while ultimatealpr is still running gates its scores
//_WARNING4: against the wrong distribution and breaks recognition.

thresholds.//_app_detect_min: 0.50 was a no-op on PR: dscore p25 is 0.880 and
thresholds.//_app_ocr_min: PR's scale sits far higher than ultimateALPR's

thresholds.//_group: Group floors match the per-frame gates. Raising the OCR
thresholds.//_group2: floor to 0.95 killed a no-plate confirm on test footage but
thresholds.//_group3: cost real LJS plates in the 0.87-0.94 band (94% -> 76%
thresholds.//_group4: confirm rate). If no-plate confirms appear at LJS, try 0.90
thresholds.//_group5: here FIRST - do not touch high_ocr_single_frame.
thresholds.//_fast: One frame at/above this confirms without waiting for a
thresholds.//_fast2: second agreeing read. Cannot be disabled: cars producing a
thresholds.//_fast3: single read exist, and voting alone drops recall to 17/21.
thresholds.//_vote: Unchanged. NOTE presence.vote_min_frames OVERRIDES this key
thresholds.//_vote2: when present (config.py ~1224) - keep both in step.

//_not_a_threshold_problem: LJS's observed failure mode is choppy
//_not_a_threshold_problem2: duplicates and background vehicles. No gate
//_not_a_threshold_problem3: fixes either; dwell_zone does, and it is
